knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Prompt investigation finds the cause and prevents a repeat. Ignoring or delaying the review does not.
Prompt sharing lets staff act on gaps. Keeping results private or sending them only to an accountant does not.
Aggregate reports show patterns that point to hazards, control changes and training needs.

practicalCriteria: Given a sample event, the learner records the cause in the system and one action, and the assessor agrees the cause is systemic rather than personal, or explains why
The learner completes an audit of six observed items and feeds back the result within a set time in a role-play
The learner reads a three-month summary and names one hazard, one control change and one training need
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Aggregate summary with the three named items
stopWorkCriteria: Stop an audit if observation would breach a person's privacy or dignity; escalate
Stop any action that singles out one person before the system has been checked
